retrievalProfile.description: A cinematic sports-themed layout featuring a central figure performing a chalk toss in a crowded arena under a digital scoreboard.
excludeWhen: requesting a bright daylight outdoor setting

recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, wide-shot composition of a basketball player from behind, arms raised in a chalk-toss gesture, centered within a dark, atmospheric arena with a glowing scoreboard at the top and a dense crowd in the background.
coreVisualRelationships: The scoreboard acts as a top-weighted frame for the central typography.
The chalk cloud creates a vertical visual bridge between the subject and the title.
The stadium lights create a horizontal band of lens flare that divides the upper and lower halves.
The subject's yellow jersey provides the primary color contrast against the dark blue arena.
coreInvariants: Central vertical alignment of subject, chalk, and text.
Digital scoreboard positioned at the top edge.
Atmospheric haze and lens flare effects.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered in the lower third, scaled to appear small against the vastness of the arena.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The bright white chalk cloud in the center of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the scoreboard at the top, down through the typography, following the chalk cloud to the subject at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark, atmospheric space in the upper mid-section allows the white typography to stand out.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and charcoal grey provide the atmospheric background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white for typography and chalk effects.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant yellow and purple from the jersey; red digital numbers on the scoreboard.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark arena shadows and the glowing stadium lights and digital displays.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses a heavy, aggressive brush-stroke script with a slight italic lean.
Secondary title uses a clean, wide-tracked geometric sans-serif.
Scoreboard text uses a segmented digital display style.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'L' and 'J' in the script title have elongated, sharp tails.
The 'V' in the sans-serif title has a perfectly symmetrical geometric vertex.

composition.relationshipToImage: placed over the dark arena space

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a clean, modern sans-serif and a raw, expressive brush script.

preserve: Aggressive brush texture on the script

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric, wide-tracked secondary title.
Captures the aggressive, textured feel of the main title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic wide shot of a basketball arena from a low angle. In the foreground, a player in a yellow jersey is seen from behind with arms raised. A large cloud of white chalk dust erupts from their hands. The background is a dark, crowded stadium with glowing blue lens flares. At the very top, include a digital scoreboard with red and yellow numbers.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the secondary title in a wide-tracked white sans-serif centered above the main title. Add the main title in a large, white, textured brush script centered in the middle of the upper half.

verificationChecks: Is the scoreboard at the top edge?
Is the chalk cloud centered and vertical?
Is the typography white and high-contrast?
Is the subject viewed from behind?

mustRedesign: Do not use specific team logos
Do not use specific player likenesses
Do not use existing brand trademarks
postGenerationChecks: Check for central alignment of all elements.
Ensure the scoreboard looks integrated into the ceiling.
Verify the brush texture on the script is visible.
Confirm the lens flare does not obscure the text.
recipe.reuseFormula: Arena Background + Scoreboard Header + Central Chalk Toss Subject + Stacked High-Contrast Typography
